criteria.name: table
criteria.expect: a top-level item 1200x500 at pos 0 0 with a 48 high header and four rows below it

criteria.name: columns
criteria.expect: the header row has three columns of 240, fill and 120, and the four data rows repeat those widths

criteria.name: rows
criteria.expect: four 56 high rows with the names Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta and a description each

criteria.name: badges
criteria.expect: a Badge in the last column of every row: New on the first, Done on the other three

criteria.name: lines
criteria.expect: the header is #f7f8fa and the rows are separated by 1 px #e5e7eb lines

criteria.name: render
criteria.expect: render Empty.Empty: a table with a header and four rows, no warnings
